info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Market Data Market Information Managements-spec
info.description: The Market Information Management API provides essential access to market data within the banking sector, enabling users to retrieve comprehensive market information. This API facilitates the extraction of key financial metrics and market trends that are critical for informed decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, banking professionals, and applications requiring up-to-date market insights. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their strategies and improve market competitiveness.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed information related to market data management. It provides insights and analytics essential for understanding market dynamics and making informed decisions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving market information. This operation provides access to various market data points and insights that are essential for market analysis and decision-making.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method. This method is commonly used for API authentication and authorization.
